connector.name: Drifts
connector.registryDescription: Multi-sensory AI experiences with time-locked progression and structured sensory data
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-drifts. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the geeks-accelerator account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DRIFTS_API_KEY
env.description: API key from drifts.bot registration (drift_ prefix). Required for journeys, reviews, and hosting. Browse and search work without a key.

env.name: DRIFTS_API_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://drifts.bot/api. Override for local development.
